title: Sin Nature
definition: Sin Nature refers to a particular way Scripture exposes sin’s corruption and danger.
summary: Sin Nature refers to a particular way Scripture exposes sin’s corruption and danger.
christFocus: Jesus brings forgiveness, cleansing, and new obedience through His cross and Spirit.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Sin Nature teaches that sin distorts worship, desire, relationships, truth, and obedience before God. Scripture tells the truth about humanity without denying dignity and without minimizing the ruin sin has brought.

God gives this truth so people may stop hiding and come into the light. People may excuse or minimize sin until it becomes bondage or self-deception. The Bible’s honesty is mercy because what remains hidden cannot be healed rightly.

Christ enters the truth this doctrine exposes. Jesus brings forgiveness, cleansing, and new obedience through His cross and Spirit. In Him, sinners are not left under guilt, shame, bondage, fear, or death; they are called to repentance, faith, restoration, and new life by the power of the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People need this truth because sin, shame, weakness, and brokenness are not solved by denial. People may excuse or minimize sin until it becomes bondage or self-deception. Scripture tells the truth so that people may stop hiding and come to Christ.

It also protects believers from shallow answers. Humanity needs forgiveness, new birth, restoration, and Spirit-empowered obedience, not merely better circumstances or stronger willpower.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Confess this sin honestly and ask the Spirit to form Christlike obedience. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
